company.name: Pavoot
company.shortDescription: Pavoot provides an AI agent that manages event workflows and turns event engagement into sales pipeline.
company.description: Pavoot provides an AI agent that manages end-to-end workflows for customer and marketing events. The platform helps marketing and sales teams identify and source relevant attendees, personalize invitations, and tailor guest experiences based on interests and context. During events, Pavoot supports event operations by structuring media, tagging assets with event-aware metadata, and organizing content for different stakeholders. After events, it helps identify top leads, generate personalized follow-ups, and route engagement data into existing sales processes. Pavoot focuses on turning event interactions and media into structured, reusable assets that support customer journeys and revenue generation.
